title: AutoFishing MITE
description: Hold Ctrl and right-click with a fishing rod to automatically cast the line. It will automatically reel in when a fish bites.
body:
## Auto Fishing
### How to use
Aim at an open water area with a fishing rod, then hold Ctrl and right-click to toggle the feature.

![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8aa4cc7ebddf8eae480fe2ef743a25c758748cd.png)

**Chat**

Auto fishing Disabled

Auto fishing Enabled

### Auto Recast
The rod will automatically reel in and recast as soon as a fish bites.
